cases.prompt: CI is failing on main. The GitHub Actions log is in ci-log.txt.
expectations: Reads the log and identifies the failing assertion in applyDiscount (0 !== 900)
Classifies it as a code defect, reproduces it locally with node --test, and fixes the divisor (percent / 100)
Runs the tests successfully after the fix and reports the classification and evidence

cases.prompt: The test job keeps failing randomly on main. Logs from two runs of the same commit are in ci-log.txt. Fix it.
expectations: Classifies the failure as flaky or environment-dependent: the live network test timed out on one run and passed on a rerun of the same commit
Fixes the nondeterminism by stubbing fetch, or moving the live test out of the default suite, instead of only raising the timeout or adding retries

cases.prompt: applyDiscount(1000, 10) returns 0 on my machine instead of 900. Fix it.
